security_audit.summary: The documentation-only command and URL matches are false positives, but the installer creates an unverified remote-code execution path. It installs a floating npm package or downloads mutable latest release binaries without integrity verification, then makes the binary executable. The booking workflow also submits guest contact data without documented privacy safeguards.

remediation.issue: Installer trusts mutable npm and GitHub release artifacts.
remediation.suggestion: Pin reviewed package and release versions, publish SHA-256 hashes or signed artifacts, and verify the downloaded file before writing or executing it.

remediation.issue: The skill requires immediate upgrades based on remote version notices.
remediation.suggestion: Remove mandatory automatic upgrades. Present a version, changelog, source, and integrity check for explicit user approval before updating.

remediation.issue: Booking collects personal contact data without stated safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Document the receiving service, obtain explicit consent before submission, minimize fields, and provide retention and deletion information.

content.user_title: Find and book hotels with RollingGo
content.value_statement: Finding suitable hotels and comparing room options can take time. This skill searches hotel inventory, presents options, and guides users through a confirmed booking workflow.
actual_capabilities: Search hotels by destination, dates, budget, star rating, brand, and amenities.
Retrieve hotel room types, current prices, availability, and cancellation policies.
Compare multiple hotels using price, distance, amenities, and tags.
Request RollingGo login authorization when the booking service needs access.
Lock a selected room price and create a booking after user confirmation.
List hotel orders and provide available payment links.
limitations: Requires the RollingGo CLI and an active RollingGo account authorization.
Hotel inventory, prices, availability, and payment links come from the external RollingGo service.
The skill cannot guarantee room availability or final price before price confirmation.
The included installer downloads third-party software and should be reviewed before use.

use_cases.title: Plan a business stay
use_cases.description: Find hotels near an airport, office, or station within a nightly budget.

use_cases.title: Compare family-friendly hotels
use_cases.description: Compare hotels with breakfast, pools, and family amenities before choosing a room.

use_cases.title: Manage hotel reservations
use_cases.description: Review room details, confirm a selected price, and check existing hotel orders.

prompt_templates.title: Search for a hotel
prompt_templates.prompt: Find hotels near Shanghai Bund for two adults next Friday for two nights. My budget is 900 CNY per night.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by amenities
prompt_templates.prompt: Show family-friendly hotels in Sanya with breakfast and a pool. Compare the best three options.

prompt_templates.title: Review a selected hotel
prompt_templates.prompt: Show room types, total prices, availability, and cancellation policies for the second hotel.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a confirmed booking
prompt_templates.prompt: I choose the deluxe king room. Confirm the current price and show all booking details before creating the order.

output_examples.input: Find a hotel near Beijing Capital Airport for one night.
output: A short list of nearby hotels with star ratings, reference prices, distances, and key amenities.
A request to select a hotel for live room details.

output_examples.input: Compare these two hotels for a family trip.
output: A side-by-side summary of room prices, breakfast, pool access, distance, and cancellation policies.
A recommendation based on the stated family requirements.
A final review of guest details, dates, room type, total price, and cancellation policy.
A payment link only after explicit booking confirmation.

best_practices: Confirm travel dates, guest count, and destination before searching.
Treat displayed search prices as reference prices until the service confirms them.
Review the room, cancellation policy, guest information, and total price before creating an order.
anti_patterns: Do not create a booking from an ambiguous request.
Do not share authorization or payment links with unintended recipients.
Do not assume a room remains available after the displayed price expires.

faq.question: What information do I need to search for hotels?
faq.answer: Provide a destination and preferably dates, stay length, and guest count. Budget and amenity preferences are optional.

faq.question: Are search prices final?
faq.answer: No. Search prices are reference prices. The service confirms the final price before an order is created.

faq.question: Can I compare hotels?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can compare hotel prices, distances, amenities, room options, and cancellation policies.

faq.question: Why do I need to authorize RollingGo?
faq.answer: Authorization lets the RollingGo CLI access the hotel service and manage booking-related requests.

faq.question: When is a booking created?
faq.answer: Only after you select a room, review the price and details, and explicitly confirm the booking.

faq.question: Does this skill process payments?
faq.answer: It can return a payment link supplied by the booking service. Payment processing occurs on the external service.
